title: Provisioning Checklist and Interactive Canvas for Dedicated Capacity Onboarding
creator: Aisha Patel
description: Design an illustrated provisioning checklist and an interactive canvas that walk customers through Dedicated capacity setup: select GPU pool size, configure autoscaling policies, set SLA targets, and validate networking/KMS prerequisites. Deliverables: hi-fi Figma mockups for desktop and tablet, annotated screenshot assets for the docs site, an interactive prototype for the Console team to embed, and a lightweight PDF runbook for account execs.
acceptance_criteria: Figma file with annotated frames for each checklist step (Estimate capacity, Network & KMS, Autoscale policy, SLA selection, Review & Confirm)
Interactive canvas prototype (Figma prototype link + annotated handoff notes) demonstrating progressive disclosure and in-context help
Set of 6 export-ready screenshot assets (desktop + tablet variants) sized and named for docs and marketing use
A one-page PDF runbook summarizing checklist items with quick troubleshooting tips
Design tokens and microcopy approved by PM and Localization team
high_level_flow: Start -> Quick capacity estimate (slider + sample workloads) -> Network & KMS check (pass/fail with remediation) -> Autoscale policy composer (min/max/scale-in/scale-out rules) -> SLA selector (latency/availability tiers + cost delta) -> Review & provision (summary card + CTA)
review_comments: 2025-01-22 - Morgan Lee (PM): Add explicit 'what's required for on-prem' callout in Network step; emphasize KMS not required for hosted trials.
2025-01-25 - Priya Narayanan (Eng): Suggested showing expected token throughput in capacity estimate step and include an overflow behavior note for KV cache.
2025-01-28 - Devon Chen (Backend): Flag: autoscale burst mode needs extra approval for some plans; include connection to billing quote in review step.
2025-01-30 - Localization: Provide length budget for CTA copy and verify Spanish microcopy fits button
decisions: Use progressive disclosure: show minimal options first (quick estimate), reveal advanced options via 'Show advanced' toggles
Illustration metaphor: use a lightweight 'power gauge' to communicate provisioned throughput instead of raw GPU counts
Autoscale composer should default to conservative min/max based on common workloads; engineers will provide sampled defaults
Separate 'SLA overview' into collapsible comparison cards with clear cost delta lines to help sales and self-serve users
implementation_notes: Engineers will expose an API endpoint for estimated throughput by pool size (ENG-20451) - use this for live preview
Prototype should include measured token/sec numbers produced from runtime benchmarks (runtime-1.18 perf lab)
Provide the Console team with annotated export PNGs at 2x and 1x for responsive breakpoints
